independent_combinatorial_check.outside_example: Distance vector (0,0,3,3) has squared norm 18 and is wholly outside the radius-4 ball

correction.outside_proof_unchanged: Only cells whose minimum distance proves them wholly outside the ball are excluded; all remaining cells still undergo denominator classification
